# Hooosberg AI (@Hooosberg)

> Hooosberg is a public notebook for real product work in the AI era: independent apps, AI tools, launch notes, failed-product postmortems, AI coding workflows, and long-term build diaries.

## Core Products & Apps
- [WitNote](https://hooosberg.com/apps/witnote): Local-first Markdown and AI workspace with offline device-side models.
- [DockTouchBar](https://hooosberg.com/apps/docktouchbar): macOS Touch Bar custom widget, app launcher, and AI agent vibe status viewer.
- [LeanTake](https://hooosberg.com/apps/leantake): Zero-edit Mac screen recorder that produces ready-to-play videos immediately.
- [AgentLimb](https://hooosberg.com/apps/agentlimb): Universal browser control infrastructure for Claude Code, Codex, and enterprise AI workflows.
- [DrowseBook](https://hooosberg.com/apps/drowsebook): Quiet reading and bedtime digital wellness companion with text-to-speech.
- [Mood Button](https://hooosberg.com/apps/mood-button): Local AI emotional voice diary powered by Apple MLX and Qwen3 on iOS App Store.
- [Codex Quota Calendar](https://hooosberg.com/apps/codex-quota-calendar): macOS menu bar calendar for tracking OpenAI Codex quota rhythms.
- [Sumi Mahjong](https://hooosberg.com/apps/sumi-mahjong): Minimalist zen ink-wash tile matching puzzle game with zero ads or tracking.
- [TrekReel](https://hooosberg.com/apps/trekreel): 3D cinematic trail story visualizer for GPX / KML outdoor routes.
- [Rushi](https://hooosberg.com/apps/rushi): Mindfulness, Buddhist sutra reading, and digital scripture copying app for iOS.
- [All Products Directory](https://hooosberg.com/apps): Complete matrix of independent AI tools and applications.

## AI Navigation & Tool Guide
- [AI Tool Directory](https://hooosberg.com/ai-navigation): Curated directory of practical global and regional AI tools: top assistants, coding agents, model APIs, design tools, hosting, and launch channels.
- [AI Model Tier List](https://hooosberg.com/ai-navigation?mode=sanguo): Combat ranking of foundation models (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen).

## Practical AI Tutorials & Learning Notes
- [AI Office Automation Masterclass](https://hooosberg.com/blog): Complete guide to automating daily office workflows using AI, Python, WorkBuddy, and agents.
- [Codex & Claude Code Engineering](https://hooosberg.com/blog): Repository-level AI coding, terminal agents, prompt strategies, and real software delivery workflows.
- [Failed Product Postmortems](https://hooosberg.com/blog): Honest postmortems on indie app launches, marketing rejections, and commercial lessons.
